issues.title: Dengue cuts short promising career of nine-year-old chess prodigy in Philippines
issues.title_en: Dengue cuts short promising career of nine-year-old chess prodigy in Philippines
issues.summary: CEBU CITY, (Philippines): A nine-year-old chess prodigy from Talisay City, Cebu, who had already won several major titles and was preparing for a shot at the Philippine National Chess Championship, was laid to rest on Thursday (Nov 5) afternoon, days after he died of dengue.
